verdict.rationale: Clerky documents its own Partner API, but it covers only one workflow: Delaware C-Corp formation document sets. Its OAuth access is described as 'coming soon', and the remote MCP server is read-only. Most UI capabilities have no documented API surface, including safes and notes, stock plans, IRS filings, bank applications, collaboration and attorney review. missing for 10: API coverage of SAFEs/convertible notes, equity/stock plans, IRS filings, bank applications, collaboration/reviewer management, launched (not 'coming soon') authentication, write-capable MCP tools, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It currently supports Delaware C-Corporation formations.
